reason: Remember-me duration changes only for persistent application cookies in the shared Identity OnSigningIn callback, including the existing recovery-code persistence bridge. Nonpersistent/default sessions remain eight hours, pending MFA five minutes and sliding expiration false. RememberMeTests covers password Staff, Owner authenticator and recovery true/false/omitted, cookie expiry at 8/12h, CSRF, logout and recovery reuse. OwnerMfaTests, OwnerMfaRecoveryTests and AuthReadinessTests cover shared identity callers/readiness/revocation; AuthReadiness web tests cover checkbox default/propagation and 12h copy. No API DTO/schema/dependency/Compose change. Identity stamp validation remains active while automatic cookie lifetime renewal is suppressed; new persistent-session stamp-revocation/inactive-account cases protect that boundary, and 4h/8h reads must not renew cookies.
